name: SvelteKit
summary: A framework for full web apps using Svelte, with pages and private server code in one project.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the MIT license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Adapters let the same app deploy to Node servers, serverless hosts or static hosting.

language.note: Written in TypeScript or JavaScript with Svelte components.

has_server_code.note: Server load functions, form actions and API routes run only on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: SvelteKit uses Svelte components, not React.

setup.step: Create the app with npx sv create, pick the adapter for your host, and push it to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Keep secrets in server-only files (+page.server.ts, +server.ts) and read them from $env/static/private.
